title_overlay: Ronaldo vs Messi vs Yamal vs Mbappé vs Haaland: Best Finish?
hook: Five icons, one finish each. Number one isn't even close.

items.label: The Robot
items.line: Haaland flying horizontally like gravity is optional. Bro got patched in real life.
items.clip_hint: Haaland flying volley/scissor goal, Man City vs Dortmund, Champions League Sept 2022

items.label: Turbo Kylian
items.line: World Cup final, eighty seconds after his penalty, and he volleys it like a Tuesday. Cold.
items.clip_hint: Mbappé volley for his 2nd goal, Argentina vs France, World Cup final 2022

items.label: The 16-Year-Old
items.line: Sixteen years old, Euro semifinal, curls it off the post. I was failing math at sixteen.
items.clip_hint: Lamine Yamal curler vs France, Euro 2024 semifinal

items.label: The GOAT Free Kick
items.line: Thirty-five yards against Liverpool. The keeper didn't move. Nobody did. Pure cinema.
items.clip_hint: Messi free kick vs Liverpool, Barcelona 3-0, Champions League semifinal 2019

items.label: The Bicycle
items.line: Bicycle kick so clean the away fans stood up and clapped. That's not a goal, that's a statue.
items.clip_hint: Cristiano Ronaldo bicycle kick vs Juventus, Champions League quarterfinal 2018 (incl. Juve fans applauding)

outro: Wrong order? Fix it in the comments.
